title: Best new addition to my hostessing skills!
text: Best new addition to my hostessing skills!. I absolutely loved this new kitchen gadget. This past Thanksgiving I used all three to put on a buffet to keep food warm (mashed potatoes, stuffing, corn) for my guests. It's attractive, easy to set up and a perfect size fr my side table. I love the lid holders in the back, that make it easy when guests go to serve themselves. I love the fact that the three of them slide to fit perfectly together and, unlike other reviewers, I really think the idea of having only one plug is an excellent idea (it saves space and there aren't a bunch of cords hanging around my dining room). I have nothing but good things to say and I think I will be purchasing another set (I see they are out of stock now, but hope they get more soon) to use for Christmas (as I had more veggies that I could have used two more cookers for. Oh, and the red color is great, too. Matches my kitchen just perfectly. Highly recommend to anyone for their own use or for giving as a gift to a hostess who loves to entertain.
